chapter: Cab Calloway on the road and segregation
title: Blanche Calloway
summary: Cheatham says Blanche's band equalled Cab's and she was the better entertainer before Cab's gimmick took off.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: Did you ever meet Blanche Calloway?
Now, some people have told me that Blanche actually had a better band, at one time, that she was -- she ended up in a mental institution, didn't she?
Well, at present she's in -- she's in Miami, she's a disc jockey there.
Did you ever hear her band when she had a band?
Yes. I don't think she had a better band than Cab. She had a good band, but I don't think it was any better than Cab. I think both those bands were equal.
But her band was better known at one point?
It was better known, well she was a better entertainer, at that time, before Cab became popular.
She was -- oh, she was a much better entertainer than Cab. See Cab came along with this gimmick, you know.
That's what did it and then you heard (unintelligible) Blanche Calloway. But Blanche was a great entertainer.
